external_sources.note: 仅采集域名候选；达到置信度门槛后按自动审核规则处理。上游规则策略、模块、脚本、MITM、DNS、Rewrite 一律不直接采纳。

release_policy.rule_scope: DOMAIN only; DOMAIN-SUFFIX is never generated automatically
release_policy.approval_rule: Confidence >= 0.26 is automatically APPROVED when the primary configured domain-only source supports the classification and all duplicate, conflict and critical-function veto checks pass. Secondary source corroboration adds confidence but is not mandatory.

approval_criteria.description: Primary source membership contributes 0.26 and meets the user's threshold; optional second publisher corroboration contributes an additional 0.13.

mandatory_vetoes: Any exact or suffix rule with a different effective policy blocks publication
Any unresolved conditional AND/OR/NOT overlap blocks publication
Any critical-function protection-list match blocks publication
Any skip-proxy direct-bypass match blocks publication
Any malformed source, invalid domain, duplicate ledger key or failed validator blocks publication
release_policy.review_status: Candidates below confidence 0.26 remain REVIEW; confirmed duplicates are not imported; conflicts and critical-function risks are held.
release_policy.publish_gate: No automatic configuration writes. Candidate decisions and reports only; original config remains immutable.
release_policy.confidence_interpretation: Operational evidence score, not a statistical probability or guarantee of safe blocking.
